grants.name: SBIR/STTR awards (USAF, USSF, NASA; 7 Phase I + 1 Phase II, 2020-2024)

funding_notes: Verified domain kayhan.space (www redirects to kayhan.space; newsroom also at kayhanspace.com). Kayhan Space Corp., Boulder/Lafayette, Colorado, founded 2019, makes Pathfinder space-traffic coordination software. It raised a $3.7M seed (Dec 2021), co-led by Initialized Capital and Root Ventures, and a $7M seed extension (Sep 2023) led by Space Capital and EVE Atlas. Payload reports $11M raised to date across three rounds. SEC Form D filings show $4,383,379 (2021) and $6,799,994 (2023) in equity sold, about $11.18M in total. The Form D figures likely include an earlier undisclosed pre-seed or conversions. A separate 'Kayhan Space SPV1, LLC' filed a Form D in Feb 2026 for a $241,875 pooled-fund raise (first sale Oct 2025). It is unclear whether this is a secondary or part of a new round, and it is excluded from the total. No priced Series A announced as of Oct 2026. SBIR/STTR awards total $1.59M per sbir.gov.
